"[project]/lib/replenishment.js [app-route] (ecmascript)", ((__turbopack_context__) => {
"use strict";

// Reorder point, coverage, projected stockout and status - computed in SQL from the
// forecasts table and current lots. Called by the seed script and after every stock movement.
//
//   ROP              = forecast demand during lead time + z x RMSE x sqrt(L)
//   Suggested order  = forecast for (lead time + 30-day review) + safety stock - on hand
//   Coverage         = days until cumulative forecast demand exceeds on-hand stock
//   Status priority  = stockout > below_rop > at_risk > insufficient_history > ok
__turbopack_context__.s([
    "AT_RISK_EXTRA_DAYS",
    ()=>AT_RISK_EXTRA_DAYS,
    "RECOMPUTE_SQL",
    ()=>RECOMPUTE_SQL,
    "REVIEW_PERIOD_DAYS",
    ()=>REVIEW_PERIOD_DAYS,
    "STATUS_ORDER_SQL",
    ()=>STATUS_ORDER_SQL,
    "recompute",
    ()=>recompute
]);
const REVIEW_PERIOD_DAYS = 30;
const AT_RISK_EXTRA_DAYS = 14;
const RECOMPUTE_SQL = `
WITH params AS (
  SELECT (SELECT value::date FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'as_of') AS as_of
),
sel AS (
  SELECT medicine_id, model, rmse FROM model_backtests WHERE is_selected
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.lead_time_days AS l, m.service_z AS z, oh.on_hand, sel.model, sel.rmse
  FROM medicines m
  JOIN v_on_hand oh ON oh.medicine_id = m.id
  LEFT JOIN sel ON sel.medicine_id = m.id
  WHERE ($1::int IS NULL OR m.id = $1::int)
),
fc AS (
  SELECT f.medicine_id, (f.day - p.as_of) AS k, f.qty,
         SUM(f.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY f.medicine_id ORDER BY f.day) AS cum
  FROM forecasts f, params p
  WHERE ($1::int IS NULL OR f.medicine_id = $1::int)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT b.id,
         SUM(fc.qty) FILTER (WHERE fc.k <= b.l)                    AS lt_demand,
         SUM(fc.qty) FILTER (WHERE fc.k <= b.l + ${REVIEW_PERIOD_DAYS}) AS ltr_demand,
         SUM(fc.qty) FILTER (WHERE fc.k <= ${AT_RISK_EXTRA_DAYS})   AS d_extra,
         AVG(fc.qty)                                               AS avg_daily,
         MIN(fc.k)   FILTER (WHERE fc.cum > b.on_hand)             AS first_short
  FROM base b LEFT JOIN fc ON fc.medicine_id = b.id
  GROUP BY b.id
),
calc AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.on_hand, b.model, b.rmse, b.z, b.l, a.lt_demand, a.ltr_demand, a.d_extra,
         ROUND(b.z * b.rmse * SQRT(b.l))                          AS safety,
         CASE WHEN a.first_short IS NOT NULL THEN a.first_short - 1
              WHEN a.avg_daily > 0 THEN FLOOR(b.on_hand / a.avg_daily)
              ELSE NULL END                                       AS coverage
  FROM base b JOIN agg a ON a.id = b.id
)
INSERT INTO replenishment AS r (medicine_id, on_hand, model, lt_demand, rmse, z, safety_stock, rop,
  suggested_order, coverage_days, projected_stockout, status, computed_at)
SELECT c.id, c.on_hand, c.model, ROUND(c.lt_demand, 2), c.rmse, c.z, c.safety,
       CEIL(c.lt_demand + c.safety),
       GREATEST(0, CEIL(c.ltr_demand + c.safety - c.on_hand)),
       c.coverage,
       CASE WHEN c.coverage IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT as_of FROM params) + (c.coverage::int + 1) END,
       CASE
         WHEN c.model IS NULL OR c.lt_demand IS NULL THEN
           CASE WHEN c.on_hand <= 0 THEN 'stockout' ELSE 'insufficient_history' END
         WHEN c.on_hand <= 0 THEN 'stockout'
         WHEN c.on_hand < c.lt_demand + c.safety THEN 'below_rop'
         WHEN c.on_hand < c.lt_demand + c.safety + c.d_extra THEN 'at_risk'
         ELSE 'ok'
       END,
       now()
FROM calc c
ON CONFLICT (medicine_id) DO UPDATE SET
  on_hand = EXCLUDED.on_hand, model = EXCLUDED.model, lt_demand = EXCLUDED.lt_demand,
  rmse = EXCLUDED.rmse, z = EXCLUDED.z, safety_stock = EXCLUDED.safety_stock, rop = EXCLUDED.rop,
  suggested_order = EXCLUDED.suggested_order, coverage_days = EXCLUDED.coverage_days,
  projected_stockout = EXCLUDED.projected_stockout, status = EXCLUDED.status,
  computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at
`;
const STATUS_ORDER_SQL = `CASE r.status
  WHEN 'stockout' THEN 0 WHEN 'below_rop' THEN 1 WHEN 'at_risk' THEN 2
  WHEN 'insufficient_history' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END`;
async function recompute(db, medicineId = null) {
    await db.query(RECOMPUTE_SQL, [
        medicineId
    ]);
}
}),
];

//# sourceMappingURL=%5Broot-of-the-server%5D__04qict9._.js.map
